adversarial_audit.objection: The accepted effect may fail positivity because E_h do not commute.
adversarial_audit.resolution: It is a sum of Kraus squares. The identity with F_H-F_H^2 also proves positivity since 0<=F_H<=I.

adversarial_audit.objection: This is merely the forbidden tiny-scale global spectral filter.
adversarial_audit.resolution: No eigenvalue estimation is used. Coherent interference within H rescales the selected common mode to one.

adversarial_audit.objection: Removing exact common cores controls every near-common spike.
adversarial_audit.resolution: No. Eigenvalues near one are attenuated, but an all-n bound after composing multiple families is still needed.

adversarial_audit.objection: The invariant projectors are already efficiently implementable from an S_n QFT.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Yes. One does not need a Kronecker basis: uniform group averaging gives E_h as a Kraus block, while QFT-conjugated left multiplication implements every irrep action.

claim_gate.reason: The first genuinely nonlocal unit-scale common-core filter has a polynomial invariant-projector circuit schema, but its all-n postfilter spectrum, retained information, and decoder are open.

falsifiers_triggered: The common-core spike can be addressed at unit scale by coherent orientation interference; generic low-pass phase estimation is not the only algebraic route.
Disjoint branchwise isotypic deletion is unnecessary for the filter identity, so the local-filter no-go does not apply.
No speedup is claimed until postfilter scaling, retained hidden-label information, and decoding are proved.

proof_obligations.resolution: Character orthogonality gives sum_z G_z^*G_z=|H|^-1 sum_h E_h=F_H exactly.
The trivial Kraus operator is G_0=F_H, hence accepting all other characters has effect F_H-F_H^2.
Every common vector has F_H eigenvalue one and is in the kernel of F_H-F_H^2.
self_dual_wreath_invariant_projector_circuit.py proves a polynomial projected encoding using uniform group averaging, reversible left multiplication, and Beals' S_n QFT.
The local block effect is not yet composed with a complete covariant hidden-permutation measurement and decoder.

summary: Constructed a coherent orientation-character filter with effect F_H-F_H^2 that exactly removes selected common cores without factorial-scale spectral estimation.

theorem_contract.accepted_effect: Accepting z!=0 implements D_H=F_H-F_H^2, with spectrum lambda(1-lambda) in [0,1/4].
theorem_contract.coherent_kraus: G_z=|H|^-1 sum_h (-1)^(z.h)E_h after a binary Fourier transform of the orientation control.
theorem_contract.common_core: intersection_h Ran(E_h) is the eigenvalue-one space of F_H and is annihilated exactly by D_H.
theorem_contract.implementation_boundary: Efficient uniform-mask preparation and binary Fourier transform are elementary; controlled E_h has a polynomial projected circuit. Postfilter information is the boundary.
theorem_contract.scale_bypass: The selected family is normalized internally, so its common core sits at eigenvalue one rather than |H|/2^k.
